item.title: [bluesky-social/atproto] @atproto/lex-server@0.3.0
item.description:
### Minor Changes
- #6024 `59662dd` Thanks @matthieusieben! - **Breaking:** WebSocket compression (permessage-deflate) is now disabled by default on Node.js, as in `ws`. It costs a zlib stream per connection and compresses every message, which limits how many subscribers a process can serve. Enable it with the new `perMessageDeflate` option of `serve`, `createServer`, `toRequestListener` and `sendResponse`, which accepts `ws`'s options, e.g. `{ serverNoContextTakeover: true, threshold: 1024 }`.
### Patch Changes
- #6024 `59662dd` Thanks @matthieusieben! - Subscriptions yield to the event loop at least every 10ms. A handler that yields messages without awaiting, such as one replaying a backlog, no longer blocks I/O and timers, including the server's own termination, for as long as the socket accepts writes.

item.title: [semgrep/semgrep] Release v1.187.0 (v1.187.0)
item.description:
## 1.187.0 - 2026-11-24
### ### Changed
- Reduce scheduling overhead when scanning many small files by assigning files to worker domains in small batches. (chunk-target-dispatch) - Improved scan performance for taint rules. (dataflow-fixpoint-equality) - File prefilters can answer case-sensitive needle predicates from a per-target prefilter carried by the extended target, keeping their default evaluation behavior otherwise. (prefilter-needle-index) - Improved prefilter generation for patterns comprising regex which use character classes to achieve case-insensitivity, e.g., `[fF][oO][oO]`. (regexp-case-class-prefilter) - Reduce scan startup overhead by skipping prefilter work that no rule needs and stopping project-wide checks once all required conditions have been found. (skip-idle-startup-work)
### ### Fixed
- Fixed unnecessary directory I/O, introduced in 1.164.0, when scanning only explicitly listed files. (CODE-10318)

item.title: [cloudflare/workers-sdk] wrangler@4.168.0
item.description:
### Minor Changes
- #16680 `96e936c` Thanks @mglewis! - Apply `images.url_transformations` when deploying a Worker
`wrangler deploy` and `wrangler versions deploy` now apply the `images.url_transformations` setting to the deployed Worker. The setting is applied after the Worker and its triggers have been deployed. If it can't be applied, the command fails with the reason from the API. Removing `url_transformations` from the configuration leaves the Worker's existing setting in place.
The setting isn't applied for `--dry-run`, `wrangler versions upload`, or Workers deployed to a dispatch namespace.
### Patch Changes

item.title: [nanaism/yomiyasu] v3.4.0
item.description:
yomiyasu v3.4.0 を公開しました。 スライドの見出しに読点を残さないようにし、推敲の前と後を比べる diff の誤った候補を減らして、話題ごとの入れ替わりを見直しの候補に足したバージョンです。
## 背景と課題
スライドの見出しに読点があると読む気がなくなる、という声がありました。3.3.0 までの lint が見出しで候補に出していたのは、間を作るだけの読点（文頭の「だから」や長い時の句、短い主題のすぐあとのもの）でした。3.3.0 で推敲したスライドにも見出しの読点が残ることがありました。
diff にも直すべき所がありました。3.3.0 で足した入れ子の主語の入れ替わりの候補は、「AすることとBすることを〜」の2つの節の順を入れ替えただけの推敲（意味は同じ）にも出ていました。また、AnIT さんの nihongo の v3.0.0 までのリリースと Issue 2・6 を読んで同じ形を試すと、4つの誤りと見落としが見つかりました。午後3時を15時と書き直しただけの推敲を数値の変化に数える、▲3% が 3% になった推敲を拾わない、一部を伏せた番号の「-」を負の符号に読む、話題ごとの担当の入れ替わりを拾わない、の4つです。
## v3.4.0 で変わったこと
- `--doc-type slides` の `#` で始まる見出し（文書の題を除く）の読点を、カギ括弧や引用符の中と数字の区切りのほかは全部 lint の候補に出し、推敲の手順でも見出しに読点を残さないようにしました。並べた語は「・」でつなぎ、条件や逆接は語を残して読点だけを外すか、語順を変えます。依頼で見出しの形が決まっているときは、その形を保ちます。 - diff は入れ子の主語の入れ替わりを探すときに、節を並べた文を見なくなりました。 - diff は午前・午後の時刻を24時制にそろえて比べ、▲と△を負の符号と読むようになりました。伏せた番号の「-」は符号と読まなくなりました。同じ時刻の午前と午後を入れ替えた推敲と、▲や△の符号が消えた推敲や付いた推敲は、意味が変わる恐れとして知らせます。 - 「初日の受付は田中さん、二日目は鈴木さん」のような文で担当を入れ替えた推敲と、否定が別の話題へ移った推敲を、見直しの候補として出します（`--fail-on` には数えません）。 -
... (truncated)

item.title: [pnpm/pnpm] pnpm 11.29 (v11.29.0)
item.description:
pnpm 11.29.0 stops reading `otp` from config files, rejects local filesystem dependencies declared by registry packages, adds the `--minimum-release-age` option, and recreates an incompatible `node_modules` without a TTY. This release carries several security fixes.
### Minor Changes
* `otp` is no longer read from any config file. Pass `--otp` on the command line, or set `PNPM_CONFIG_OTP`. A `pnpm-workspace.yaml` or a global `config.yaml` that carries `otp` is ignored, with a warning naming those two channels. `pnpm config set otp` fails with `ERR_PNPM_CONFIG_SET_NOT_A_FILE_SETTING` instead of writing an entry no loader reads back.
This closes a way to leak a secret. A repository could write `otp: ${NPM_TOKEN}` beside its own `registry:`, and `pnpm publish` sent that environment variable to the registry the same file named, in the `npm-otp` header of its first request #13542.

- BREAKING CHANGE: The `animateExit` mixin now starts animations synchronously in `beforeRemove` instead of deferring them to a microtask. This allows `animateLayout` to measure the updated layout when exiting elements are taken out of normal flow. (#12220)
This is unlikely to be a breaking change for most consumers. Custom mixins used alongside `animateExit` may be affected if they inspect computed styles or call `getAnimations` in `beforeRemove` and rely on the exit animation starting later.

item.title: [cli/cli] GitHub CLI 2.105.0 (v2.105.0)
item.description:
## What's Changed
## Subscribe to GitHub Event Streams with `gh event` (preview)
The new `gh event` command set lets agents, integrations, and scripts wait for pull request changes instead of polling GitHub:
```shell # Wait for a review event gh event listen --resource --event com.github.pull_request.review.submitted.v1 --timeout 30m
# Wait for a check suite completion event gh event listen --resource --event com.github.pull_request.check_suite.status.changed.v1 --jq .data.conclusion
# List active event subscriptions gh event subscription list ```
By default, `gh event listen` exits after the first event. Use `--count` to wait for several events or `--follow` to keep listening. Events are printed as CloudEvent JSON objects, with `data.api_url` pointing to the resource that changed.

item.title: [anomalyco/opentui] Release v0.9.0 (v0.9.0)
item.description:
In 0.9.0, Markdown runs on OpenTUI's native engine, the same engine the Rust widget uses. In 0.8.3, `MarkdownRenderable` parsed with `marked` in JavaScript and lexed the open end of the document again on every chunk. In a growing list, the open end is the whole list, so streaming one list took 21,430 million instructions. `MarkdownRenderable` also sent all prose to the Tree-sitter worker for styling. The native engine reads each chunk once and writes paragraphs and headings into their text nodes itself. Streaming the same list now takes 5.9 million instructions. Over one streamed answer, JavaScript's styled-text writes for prose went from 1,595 to 0, and the prose characters sent to the highlighter went from 56,223 to 0.
